notes.title: Update 9.5 coming tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b]
Tomorrow the [b]9.5 Update[/b] officially launches as a full release![/p][p]For Quest players: the Meta Quest version has been pushed back to [b]9/12[/b] since Meta is not allowing our builds.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Visitor Update[/b]
After [i]The Visitor[/i] was rifted back, strange rifts in different colors have started appearing across the world. Why are they here? What do they mean? Investigate it and report back to us.[/p]

notes.title: Update 10 coming soon
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197305/1c3521acfca56b09794d0f4d30533c447638b969.png"][/img]Update 10 will be coming out in the upcoming months. We are sorry for not fulfilling our promises and not posting any announcements of delays.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Menus[/h1][p]We are working on improving all the menus in the game, and it will be ready in the Meta Quest update![/p][p][/p][h1]Meta Quest Release[/h1][p]This month, you’ll be able to play DUST without needing a computer or SideQuest! You can join up with Steam players and hop into their lobbies. If you’d rather not have Steam or Meta Quest players in your lobby, you can easily turn off crossplay in the lobby settings.[/p][p][/p][h1]THE FINALE[/h1][p]In November, come join us to watch the visitor fly into the sky again, but something is very different this time..[/p][p][/p][h1]Discord server[/h1][p]We are excited to announce that we are opening a server, and we will share the server link in the next announcement.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Warped Chaos update coming soon
notes.notes: [p]Ever since we warped back to version 9, things just haven't been the same. The Visitor is nowhere to be found, and the abandoned factory is a complete mess.[/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone, we’re sorry we couldn’t release the story mode multiplayer this month. We’ve been super busy, but now we are excited to share the latest changes coming to Dust![/p][p][/p][h1]New Main Menu[/h1][p]We are excited to announce a complete revamp of the main menu, with all other menus also getting a fresh new look! [/p][p][/p][p]This will be available in beta and can be activated through the developer menu.[/p][p][/p][h1]The Launch[/h1][p]The rocket has been warped back, and we're not sure if it's ready yet, but it seems the visitor has been working hard.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of live events, you’ll soon have the option to start an event near the emergency leave menu.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's everything for today! Have a great day![/p]

notes.title: Update is live on the nightly build!
notes.notes:
The beta phase will end on April 25, 2025. During this time, a total of 10 updates will be released before its end.

---

[h1]Leaving the Sidequest Store[/h1]
We are working on getting DUST onto the Meta Quest store. We will notify everyone when DUST is ready for release there.

---

[h1]Other News[/h1]
**Story Mode Co-Op:** Experience the full story with up to 4 players!  
We will hopefully ship this feature out next month.

Stay tuned for more updates soon. Thank you for playing!
